cds.title: Tennessee Technological University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: Fall 2025 first-year class (CDS C1). International applicants were admitted at 37.2% (291 of 782) versus 78.7% overall, so admission is much tighter for internationals than the headline rate; the CDS reports 0 international enrollees in its residency table although B2 shows 14 nonresident first-time first-year students. 9,306 is the B1 total undergraduate count and 146 the B2 nonresident total. Rolling admission, no waitlist, no deferred admission. Percentiles are for enrolled students; 3% submitted SAT (69 students), 94% ACT (1,909).

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year, 2026-27). The CDS 'Nonresident' tuition row ($27,126) is used as the international rate; it lists a separate lower 'Out-of-state' rate ($14,670) for U.S. out-of-state students. 'Other' = transportation $2,800 + other expenses $2,500. The CDS box says final 2026-27 costs were not yet available when it was filed. CDS H6: 91 nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid (total $1,456,356, average $16,003).
